source: 用户补充实际港口与未来跨镇交通；剧本11–23/109–111
prompt: Create a transparent sprite atlas with two equal square panels side by side, large empty gutters separating objects. Match the cute Chinese pixel-art town reference, warm wood, blue-grey tiled roofs, restrained chunky square pixels, no perspective vanishing points. LEFT PANEL: one Chinese wooden river cargo ferry, vertically aligned bow pointing up, narrow hull, visible deck, folded cream sail, cabin with curved blue-grey roof, rope and tiny barrels; orthographic overhead oblique game sprite, no water, no ground, full ship inside its panel. RIGHT PANEL: a small Chinese ferry wharf ticket canopy and cargo stack grouped as a horizontal shore prop, front orthographic elevation with a little visible roof, wood posts, hanging red lantern, blank noticeboard, rope coils, 3 crates, and a short stone quay edge. No dirt rectangle, no water, no characters, no letters, no labels. Objects isolated on transparent background; do not overlap or crop.
notes: 新增图集，原图只读；两艘船及候船棚采用只读AtlasTexture，不改布局/产权/水面通行。
